entity.description:
Using his suit to perform Robin Hood-esque good deeds, Morris was hailed a hero. However, his stock of back up suits was stolen by escaped criminal Henry Barnes, who started using the suits to commit armed robberies. Once Superman cleared his name, Morris was given a position as Vice President of Research and Development at Luthor Technologies.
